title: How Liquidity Bootstrapping & Fair Launch Works
mermaid:
flowchart TD
    subgraph Window["Bootstrap Window (genesis)"]
        A[New token genesis] --> B[Launchpad sells on bonding curve]
        B --> C{"Curve target reached?"}
        C -->|No| B
        C -->|Yes| D[Graduate token]
        D --> E[Create real DEX pair]
        E --> F[Add initial liquidity]
        F --> G[Mark finalized]
        G --> H[Enable token transfers]
    end
    H --> I[Live DEX trading]

title: Racing the Genesis Transaction
mermaid:
flowchart TD
    A[Attacker watches mempool] --> B{Attack surface}
    subgraph Window["Empty / thin bootstrap state"]
        B -->|V1 pre-empt pair| C["Pre-create pair skewed 1e10:1 wei"]
        B -->|V2 handoff| D["Sandwich graduation, mins 0,0"]
        B -->|V3 first-LP| E["Re-initialize pool price/rate"]
        B -->|V4 flash loan| F["Game launch fees in one block"]
    end
    C --> G["Router uses attacker reserve ratio"]
    D --> G
    E --> H["Honest LP overpays or bad APR"]
    F --> H
    G --> I[Drain collected base asset]
    H --> I
    I --> J["Funds stolen or launch bricked"]

title: Hardening the Genesis Transaction
mermaid:
flowchart TD
    A[Launch contract] --> B["Atomic initialize + mint multicall"]
    B --> C["Set graduated state BEFORE liquidity"]
    C --> D[Gate pair creation to graduated flag]
    D --> E["Enforce slippage mins on graduation"]
    E --> F[Cap tokenForLiquidity to reserved supply]
    F --> G[Never derive accounting from balance]
    G --> H[Bound initial price/rate range]
    H --> I[Require minimum initial liquidity]
    I --> J[Depositor sets amounts, not spot read]
    J --> K[Restrict initializer and lock LP]
    K --> L[Manipulation-resistant fair launch]
